visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a khaki-colored crewneck sweatshirt stands in an indoor office environment. He holds a book titled '超輕量露營全攻略' (Ultralight Camp Book) in both hands, presenting it directly to the camera. His facial expression is neutral to friendly as he looks into the lens. Behind him, a computer monitor displays lines of code and data charts on a blue interface. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The perspective shifts to a top-down view of the book. The man's hands are visible as he rapidly flips through the pages. The pages showcase a high density of visual information, including high-resolution photos of camping gear like tents, stoves, and backpacks, as well as scenic outdoor photography of forests, mountains, and lakes. Text blocks and instructional diagrams are visible on every page. The movement is fast and continuous. (3) The man returns to the initial framing, holding the book once more and pointing towards it with his right hand. He maintains eye contact with the camera. The background remains the same indoor office setting with the glowing monitor. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking in a warm, conversational Mandarin tone. He is introducing a book. Underneath his voice, an upbeat acoustic guitar BGM plays with a rhythmic, major-mode folk-pop feel at a steady tempo of around 115 BPM. The environment sounds clean and studio-like. (2) A distinctive acoustic shift occurs as a rapid sequence of high-frequency 'swish' and 'rustle' sounds begins. These are the sounds of paper pages being flipped quickly. The vocal narration continues at a moderate pace, detailing the evolution of ultralight camping gear. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (3) The page-flipping noise ceases, and the male voice becomes more prominent as he issues a call to action. He encourages viewers to leave comments for a giveaway. The acoustic guitar BGM swells slightly as it reaches a natural melodic conclusion toward the end of the recording.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase for the 'Ultralight Camp Book'. It highlights the book's comprehensive content regarding lightweight camping equipment and outdoor strategies through a fast-paced page-flipping montage. The ultimate objective is to drive audience engagement via a giveaway (lucky draw) incentive mentioned at both the start and end of the clip.
